title: bug: the board's /ws UPDATE_TASK move from BLOCKED back to blockedFromStatus re-assigns the row to its recorded assignee with no owner check (WebSocketServer.ts:545), so a drag after the blocked-timeout idled a resource-parked seat strands the row on that corpse: the /ws twin of task-a133bd6a
description:
Filed by architect-74d9e1c7 on 2026-11-04 while planning task-a133bd6a. That row fixes the same defect in moe.set_task_status only; its description puts "the /ws handlers" out of scope. This row is the twin.

PROBLEM (HEAD d5431577)
- packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:507-547 is the /ws UPDATE_TASK exit from BLOCKED. Its comment says it "Mirrors src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts". On a return to blockedFromStatus it does `...(newStatus === effectiveFrom ? { assignedWorkerId: existing.assignedWorkerId } : {})` (:545), with no owner check.
- The two automatic restores keep a hold only for a worker that exists, is not DEAD and still points at the task:
  - state/dependencyUnblock.ts:255-267 (runDependencyUnblock);
  - state/resourceStore.ts:570-573 (resumeResourceHolder).
  The contract is in packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md:7.
- task-a133bd6a (WORKING, planRevision 1) adds that predicate as one exported helper, `parkedHoldOwner(state, task): string | null` in state/dependencyUnblock.ts, and calls it from setTaskStatus.ts. Once it lands, the board drag (the most common human route) is the only manual path still stranding the row.
- How the strand arises: the blocked-timeout sweep keeps a resource-waiting BLOCKED row assigned (sweeps.ts:456-460) and sets the timed-out seat IDLE with currentTaskId null (:485-489). A drag back to WORKING then restores the row onto that IDLE corpse. isTaskClaimable is false (the owner is neither missing nor DEAD), the Layer-3 prune keeps the corpse (it owns active work), and no sweep alerts. Only release_task recovers it.

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-a133-ws/zzWsUnblockCorpse.test.ts. It is a real MoeWebSocketServer on an ephemeral port, the WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts pattern, run from packages/moe-daemon/src/__hunt__/ of a whole-tree `git archive d5431577` snapshot after `npm ci`: `npx vitest run src/__hunt__/zzWsUnblockCorpse.test.ts` gives 1 failed. Output is in zzWsUnblockCorpse.vitest.txt:
  HUNT /ws UNBLOCK: {"task-ghost":{"reply":"TASK_UPDATED","status":"WORKING","assignedWorkerId":"worker-gone","claimable":true},"task-corpse":{"reply":"TASK_UPDATED","status":"WORKING","assignedWorkerId":"worker-idle","claimable":false},"task-dead":{"reply":"TASK_UPDATED","status":"WORKING","assignedWorkerId":"worker-dead","claimable":true},"task-held":{"reply":"TASK_UPDATED","status":"WORKING","assignedWorkerId":"worker-held","claimable":false}}
- What it shows:
  - task-corpse (IDLE record, currentTaskId null) is the strand: claimable false.
  - The ghost and DEAD rows keep a stale assignee.
  - task-held (a BLOCKED record pointing at the row) is the genuine hold and must stay kept.

FIX DIRECTION
- In the BLOCKED exit arm, replace `existing.assignedWorkerId` with `parkedHoldOwner(this.state, existing)`, imported from '../state/dependencyUnblock.js'. carriedBlockQuestion already comes from there. The explicit null then hands the seat back through updateTask, which also closes the task's running/reconciling attempt (MCP_SERVER.md, Close on hand-back).
- Do not change the BLOCKED-entry arm (:559-566) or any other exit.
- Docs: in docs/MCP_SERVER.md `### moe.set_task_status`, task-a133bd6a's Assignment sentence says the /ws handler "still restores the recorded assignee without that owner check". Replace that clause with "enforces the same rules". Edit only that section; it is free once task-a133bd6a is DONE, which dependsOn guarantees.

- packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.unblockOwner.test.ts (new; port the repro, asserting the correct behaviour)
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.set_task_status only)

OUT OF SCOPE: setTaskStatus.ts and dependencyUnblock.ts (task-a133bd6a); resourceStore.ts; sweeps.ts (task-fa70e835); the IDE plugins (they send the same UPDATE_TASK frame, so no client change).

executionContract.intendedBehavior: A board /ws UPDATE_TASK move of a BLOCKED row back to its blockedFromStatus keeps the recorded assignee only while that worker exists, is not DEAD and its currentTaskId still names the row. That is the rule set_task_status and both auto-unblocks apply through parkedHoldOwner. Otherwise the row returns unassigned and claimable, and the explicit-null hand-back closes the seat's running/reconciling attempt. A drag after the blocked-timeout idled a resource-parked seat therefore no longer strands the row on that corpse. Entering BLOCKED from the board still keeps the seat, and every other exit is unchanged.
